column8: ["The teal housing has weight, but the brass crescent and seat rim look like soft brown stains rather than distinct, rubbed metal; give their contact edges clearer material character.","The bright upper-left bevel and heavy dark lower edge imply directional lighting and visible thickness; model the rim with balanced, symmetric tones.","Speckled wear blankets the teal glaze, muddying its finish. Preserve quieter glazed surfaces and gather abrasion around the opening and contact edges."]

["The bright upper-left rim and deep lower-right bevel make the housing read as a raised slab with visible side faces under directional light. Keep its weight with symmetric edge shading and no hanging shadow.","The ceramic, brass crescent and dark seat lining share a soft, mottled finish. Give the glaze clearer depth, the brass distinct rubbed contact edges and the rubber a convincingly matte surface."]
